name: css-composite-font
description: Composite fonts in pure CSS: separate fonts and sizes for CJK, kana and Latin. 复合字体 / 合成フォント

paragraphs: Build a composite font the way InDesign and Illustrator do: assign a separate font, size and baseline to CJK ideographs, kana, punctuation, Latin and digits, proof the result live, and export CSS you can paste straight into a stylesheet.
features: Seven character classes plus custom exceptions. Each class has its own font, size and baseline; values you leave empty inherit from the class it follows, as in InDesign's composite font dialog.
Groups inside fullwidth symbols and shared CJK/Latin punctuation can be switched one by one, for example quotes set in the Latin font while dashes stay fullwidth.

Font sources: Google Fonts, installed fonts (local(), with the installed-font list in Chrome / Edge) and font files. The font picker checks coverage: it shows which character sets a font has (Latin, digits, kana,…

Presets for Simplified and Traditional Chinese, Japanese, manga dialogue and the macOS system fonts (PingFang / Hiragino with Avenir Next; SF Pro can't be referenced with local()). Every preset's Latin sizes and…

Multi-weight export. The fonts you set apply at 400 and the other weights are derived: Google Fonts by the same offset, installed fonts by name (W3 → W6, Regular → Bold, checked on this device), files by file name. At…
